lines.note: Ge'ez 1 combines the title with the opening of Greek 2; Ge'ez 2 completes Greek 2.
Ge'ez separates the request to know his end from the number of his days and what he lacks.
Ge'ez separates the days and existence clauses from the declaration that every living person is vanity.
Ge'ez separates walking in a shadow and vain agitation from gathering treasures for an unknown recipient.
Ge'ez 13 contains Greek 10 and the opening of 11; Ge'ez 14 completes 11 and begins 12; Ge'ez 15 completes 12.
